label: Calendly
description: Arcade tools designed for LLMs to interact with Calendly scheduling

tools.name: CancelScheduledEvent
tools.description:
Cancel a booked Calendly meeting and notify its invitees.

The meeting cannot be restored afterwards; invitees must rebook.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The meeting to cancel, as a Calendly event URI or UUID.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Reason shown to invitees in the cancellation notice. Leave empty to cancel without a stated reason.

output.description: Confirmation that the meeting was canceled

reason.value: The host has a scheduling conflict and is unable to attend the meeting at this time.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: CreateSchedulingLink
tools.description:
Create a single-use Calendly booking link for one of your event types.

Useful for sending a specific person a link that expires once they book.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: The event type to create a booking link for, as an event type URI or UUID.

parameters.name: max_event_count
parameters.description: How many bookings the link accepts before it expires. Currently only 1 is supported by Calendly. Defaults to 1.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: GetScheduledEvent
tools.description:
Get the full detail of one booked Calendly meeting.

Includes start and end times, location or join link, hosts, and cancellation
details when the meeting has been canceled.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The meeting to retrieve, as a Calendly event URI or UUID.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListAvailabilitySchedules
tools.description:
List a Calendly user's recurring availability rules and working hours.

Shows which hours the user accepts bookings on each weekday, per named schedule.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Whose schedules to list, as a Calendly user URI or UUID. Leave empty to use the connected account.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListBusyTimes
tools.description:
Find when a Calendly user is already busy over a time window.

Combines Calendly bookings with events from external calendars the user has marked
"Check for conflicts" in Calendly. A connected calendar without that setting is not
represented, so an empty result is not proof the user is free.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Beginning of the window to check, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the window to check, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Must be no more than 7 days after start_time.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Whose calendar to check, as a Calendly user URI or UUID. Leave empty to use the connected account.

output.description: Busy intervals in the requested window

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListEventAvailableTimes
tools.description:
Find the open booking slots for a Calendly event type over a time window.

Returns each slot's start time and a direct booking link, soonest first. Narrow the
window rather than raising the limit when `truncated` comes back true.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: The event type to check openings for, as an event type URI or UUID.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Beginning of the window to search, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Must be in the future.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the window to search, as an ISO 8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Must be no more than 31 days after start_time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum slots to return (1-200). Defaults to 50. A wide window on a short meeting can produce hundreds of slots, so the list is cut to this and `truncated` says when that happened.

output.description: Bookable slots in the requested window

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListEventInvitees
tools.description:
List who booked a Calendly meeting, with their emails, timezones and status.

Also returns each invitee's self-service cancel and reschedule links.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The meeting whose invitees to list, as an event URI or UUID.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return invitees in this state. Omit to return both active and canceled.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Only return the invitee with this exact email address. Leave empty to return all invitees.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum invitees to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continuation token from a previous call's next_cursor. Leave empty to start from the first page.

output.description: A page of invitees on the meeting

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListEventTypes
tools.description:
List the meeting types a Calendly user offers, with their booking links.

Returns event types in Calendly's default order.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Owner of the event types, as a Calendly user URI or UUID. Leave empty to use the connected account.

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Return only event types currently accepting bookings (true) or every event type including disabled ones (false). Defaults to true.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum event types to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continuation token from a previous call's next_cursor. Leave empty to start from the first page.

output.description: A page of bookable event types

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListOrganizationMembers
tools.description:
List the people in a Calendly organization, with their roles and booking pages.

Returns members in Calendly's default order.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Organization to list members of, as a Calendly organization URI or UUID. Leave empty to use the connected account's own organization.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Only return the member with this exact email address. Leave empty to return all members.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only return members holding this role. Omit to return all roles.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum members to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continuation token from a previous call's next_cursor. Leave empty to start from the first page.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: ListScheduledEvents
tools.description:
List a Calendly user's booked meetings, with times, locations and host details.

Covers upcoming meetings unless min_start_time is set to a past timestamp, and
returns them sorted by start time in the requested direction.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Host whose meetings to list, as a Calendly user URI or UUID. Leave empty to use the connected account.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return meetings in this state. Omit to return both active and canceled.

parameters.name: invitee_email
parameters.description: Only return meetings booked by this exact email address. Leave empty for no invitee filter.

parameters.name: min_start_time
parameters.description: Only return meetings starting at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Defaults to now, so a request that names no window returns upcoming meetings. Pass an explicit timestamp, a max_start_time, or status=CANCELED to read meeting history instead.

parameters.name: max_start_time
parameters.description: Only return meetings starting at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Leave empty for no upper bound.

parameters.name: sort_direction
parameters.description: Order meetings by start time. Defaults to ASCENDING (soonest first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum meetings to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continuation token from a previous call's next_cursor. Leave empty to start from the first page.

tools.name: MarkInviteeNoShow
tools.description:
Mark an invitee as having not attended their booked Calendly meeting.

The mark is visible in Calendly reporting and can be removed there.

parameters.name: invitee
parameters.description: The invitee who did not attend, as a Calendly invitee URI. Invitee URIs are returned alongside each invitee on a meeting.

output.description: Confirmation that the invitee was marked as a no-show

tools.name: WhoAmI
tools.description:
Get the connected Calendly account's profile, timezone and organization.

Useful for confirming whose calendar is being read or changed, and for reporting
the account's booking page and timezone back to the user.

output.description: The connected Calendly account and its organization

summary:
Calendly toolkit for Arcade lets LLMs interact with Calendly scheduling — reading availability, managing bookings, and acting on behalf of a connected Calendly account.

## Capabilities

- **Account & org inspection:** Retrieve the connected account's profile, timezone, and organization; list all members of a Calendly organization with their roles and booking pages.
- **Availability & open slots:** List a user's recurring working-hours schedules and query real-time busy periods (Calendly bookings + connected external calendars flagged for conflict-checking); find open booking slots for a specific event type over any time window.
- **Event type discovery:** List all meeting types a user offers, including their public booking links, in Calendly's default order.
- **Scheduled event management:** List, retrieve, cancel, and no-show-mark booked meetings; list invitees with their emails, timezones, status, and self-service cancel/reschedule links.
- **Single-use scheduling links:** Generate one-time booking links tied to a specific event type, suitable for sending to a particular person.

## OAuth

This toolkit authenticates via OAuth 2.0 through Calendly. See the [Calendly auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/calendly) for configuration details.
